tagline: Your own order, invoice, shipment and credit memo numbers, useful extra columns in the order grid, a test order flag and carefully guarded order deletion with an audit log.
key_features: Custom order, invoice, shipment and credit memo numbers
Prefix, suffix, padding, start value and step per store view
Date and store placeholders, optional yearly or monthly restart
Invoices and shipments can reuse the order number
Extra order grid columns: items, coupon, country, comment
Test order flag with mass actions and filter
Order deletion: off by default, own permission, allowed statuses only
Read-only Deleted Orders Log with CSV export

benefits.title: Numbers that fit your business
benefits.text: Orders like WEB-26-000123 instead of 000000123, with invoices, shipments and credit memos numbered your way or matching the order.

benefits.title: Less clicking in the order grid
benefits.text: See the ordered SKUs, coupon code, shipping country and order comment in Sales > Orders, with filters, without opening each order.

benefits.title: Deleting with guard rails
benefits.text: Deleting is off until you switch it on, needs its own permission, only accepts the statuses you allow and records every deletion in a log.

showcase.label: Document numbers
showcase.title: Your own numbering, previewed before the next order
showcase.text: Prefix, suffix, minimum length, start value and step per store view, with {yyyy}, {yy}, {mm}, {dd} and {store_id} placeholders. The Next Numbers table shows what each store view will issue next.

showcase.label: Order grid
showcase.title: More of the order in the grid
showcase.text: Items (SKU x qty), Coupon Code, Shipping Country, Order Comment and Test Order columns, each switched on separately and kept current by Magento's own grid indexer.

showcase.label: Delete from the grid
showcase.title: A clear confirmation before anything is deleted
showcase.text: The Delete Permanently mass action names the number of selected orders and what is not restored. At most 200 orders per request.

showcase.label: Status check
showcase.title: Orders with other statuses are refused
showcase.text: Every order is checked on the server against the allowed statuses (default: Canceled only), and checked again under a row lock just before it is deleted.

showcase.label: Order page
showcase.title: Delete one order from its page
showcase.text: The Delete Permanently button appears only when deleting is on, the admin role allows it and the order's status is allowed.

showcase.label: Deleted Orders Log
showcase.title: Every deletion on record
showcase.text: Order number, store view, status, grand total, deleted documents, admin user, IP address and time. Read-only, searchable, with CSV export. The customer email is stored as a hash by default.

feature_groups.title: Document numbers
items: Order, invoice, shipment and credit memo, each configured separately
Per store view, website or default scope
Placeholders {store_id} {yyyy} {yy} {mm} {dd}
Yearly or monthly restart only when the number contains the period
Atomic counters, duplicate check and fallback to Magento's number

feature_groups.title: Order grid
items: Items as "SKU x qty"
Coupon Code and Order Comment (text filters)
Shipping Country (select filter)
Test Order flag with Mark and Unmark mass actions
CLI backfill for orders placed before installation

feature_groups.title: Deleting orders
items: Off by default, own ACL resource Delete Orders
Only the order statuses you allow (default: Canceled)
POST with form key and a confirmation dialog
Removes invoices, shipments, credit memos, payment, addresses and comments
One transaction per order, together with its log entry

feature_groups.title: Admin and developers
items: Deleted Orders Log with keyword search and CSV export
Customer email in the log stored as a SHA-256 hash or in clear
Separate ACL permissions per feature
CLI: show next numbers, backfill grid columns
No storefront code, no core rewrites
